opening.argument: The video directly invites viewers to join a Forsage BUSD network-marketing platform, identifying the promoted activity as a referral program. It then links participation to immediate income, stating that a connected Trust Wallet “gets directly linked to Forsage” and that income gets “immediately in Trust Wallet.” The speaker further presents Forsage as “the official platform” operating worldwide for four to five years, while asserting that its unique business model “can't simply create a scam.” Those claims combine recruitment into a network-marketing structure with an unusually reassuring promise of immediate income and categorical assurance of safety, establishing the stated concern.
